cause.label: earnings_miss
cause.what_happened: NeoVolta reported FY2026 Q4 after the close on 2026-09-23: revenue of $13.5K against a $2.08M consensus, a loss of $0.24 a share against -$0.07, and a $3.9M credit-loss provision. It filed a $200M primary S-3 shelf and the 10-K the same day. The stock fell 24.45% on 09-24, and today's -6.3% is a low-volume continuation with no new company news found.

pipeline.next_dated_event: The resale registration for the Horizon/ROHO loan warrants is due within 30 days of the 2026-09-04 loan, so by about 2026-10-04 (1.45M shares at a $3.30 strike, above spot). The SK On pack agreement is guided 'six to eight weeks' out, around November. Neither falls inside the window.
pipeline.what_would_change_my_mind: An 8-K or 424B5 showing an overnight underwritten takedown off shelf 333-280400 would make it more negative. A Form 4 open-market insider buy filed before Monday's close would make it positive: the insider window should open after the 09-23 release, and insiders bought 3 times in the last 12 months.

positioning_check: Short interest was 4,976,955 shares at the 2026-09-15 settlement, up 9.0% from 4,568,099 on 08-31, with 3.55 days to cover (Nasdaq/FINRA). That is roughly 8-9% of the 59.0M shares outstanding on the 10-K cover (09-23). The settlement predates the print, so the position carried into the fall is not observable, and the next settlement (09-30) publishes about 10-09, outside the window. Options: 25-delta skew is unavailable, put/call open interest is 0.25 (call-heavy), and ATM IV is 122% on a 35%-of-mid spread.

findings.finding: The $30M Needham at-the-market sales agreement (dated 2026-03-27, on effective shelf 333-280400) is live and can sell stock into Monday 2026-09-28's session.
findings.mechanism_in_window: An open ATM on an effective shelf can be drawn in any session, including the one inside the window. The 2026-09-04 loan agreement's Minimum Cushion covenant counts the stock issuable under the ATM, which confirms it is live. The company also needs about $40M of JV contributions through June 2027 against $25.4M of liquidity plus the $20M loan.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: NEOV has issued equity repeatedly: a $10M registered direct in Jan-2026 at $4.76, the ATM opened in Mar-2026, and a May-2026 underwritten offering at $2.05 (12.2M shares). The baseline has no per-event reaction for ATM draws, because ATM sales are disclosed only in the next 10-Q.
findings.why_not_priced: Only weakly unpriced. The ATM is public and the new $200M shelf was read on 09-24. What the tape may not hold is continuous agent selling into a thin Friday-to-Monday bounce: dollar volume today was $3.8M, against the $30M program. On the call management described the NEW shelf as administrative and not for immediate use at current valuations, but said nothing restricting the existing ATM. If the price already held this supply, the day-2 fall would have come on heavier volume than 1.39x.
findings.independence: The 2026-09-04 8-K loan covenant names the ATM as a live funding source (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1748137/000168316826006967/neovolta_8k.htm). On the call the CFO listed 'possibly equity' among funding channels (https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-neovolta-q4-2026-miss-sparks-sharp-afterhours-drop-93CH-4914126).

outside_window.finding: The $200M primary S-3 filed 2026-09-23 is not yet effective ('Subject to Completion'), so it cannot be drawn in the window. Once effective it is a large supply overhang against a market cap of about $132M, though management called it administrative.

The resale S-3 for the Horizon/ROHO warrants (1,454,545 shares at $3.30, 5-year term) is due within 30 days of the 2026-09-04 loan, with effectiveness targeted 60 days after filing. The strike is above spot, so there is little economic supply.
Loan amortization starts 2026-12-04: the greater of $1.25M or 7.5% of the prior month's trading value, capped at $2M a month. That is a cash drain that raises equity-raise pressure.
The SK On pack manufacturing agreement is to be finalised 'within six to eight weeks' of the late-September call, with first purchase orders expected before end-2026.

baseline_tension: The findings mostly agree with the tape. This is a low-volume (1.39x) day-2 leg with no new news, and this name's own falls are a coin flip (median +0.14), both of which argue against a strong continuation call. The high ATR (13.4%) and a live ATM argue mildly the other way. So the emitted -0.3 is smaller than the -0.4 finding sum, by 0.1, because of the volume and own-history pull.
